sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: A centralized, comprehensive resource offering up-to-date spoilers, detailed reviews, and exclusive deals for a vast array of subscription boxes, enabling informed purchasing decisions.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Hello Subscription is a platform providing comprehensive reviews, spoilers, and coupon codes for a wide variety of subscription boxes across different consumer categories. It serves as a guide for consumers looking to discover, evaluate, and find deals for subscription services.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Subscription box reviews
spoilers
coupon codes
and curated deal listings.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Free for users; revenue likely generated through affiliate marketing and advertising from featured subscription box companies.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Consumers interested in discovering, subscribing to, or getting discounts on subscription boxes across various categories like beauty, food, kids, pets, and lifestyle.
